parsed.note_claim: The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a 99-year lease for the continued operation of the US military base on Diego Garcia.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: It would lease back Diego Garcia for a period of 99 years - at an average cost of £101m a year.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly states the UK will hand over sovereignty to Mauritius and lease back Diego Garcia for 99 years to secure the base.
